notes.title: Void Protocol Playtest
notes.content:
Body:
Dear Time Travelers,
The Void Protocol playtest begins May 9, 2025, 12:00 UTC. This is not just an adventure to defy causality, but a chance to co-create the future of puzzle design with us.

We Need Your Genius:

Every "Imprint" you make could redraw the boundaries of level design;

Every "Rewind" strategy you deploy helps refine the balance of mechanics;

Every piece of feedback you submit will be documented in our dev logs, becoming the foundation of the full release.

How to Participate:

Join the playtest and tear through impossible puzzles with logic;

Share your "Eureka Moments" in Discussions or our feedback form;

See your ID immortalized in the Developer Credits—your mind deserves to be etched into history.

Time won't rewind, but you can shape it into a more perfect form.

The Void Protocol Team
May 2025
